deposit recyclable and reusable material at identified location
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste

modules.module_title: Prepare for depollution and dismantling of End-of-Life vehicle

pcs.pc_description: identify the auto components related to the various aggregates in the vehicle
recognize Electric and Hybrid vehicles and High Voltage Electrical systems and their specifications for safe handling of the End-of-life vehicle
park the vehicle on a suitable platform
collect hand tools, drain pans, workshop equipment, and other special tools required for the job and check their condition/calibration
prepare the vehicle according to the nature of the job to be performed i.e. inspection, depollution and disassembling etc.
report the malfunctions if any, in the tools/equipment to the person concerned for rectification
wear PPE according to the nature the of job to be performed on the vehicle
conduct visual inspection of the vehicle for leaks from engines, radiators, transmissions, differentials, fuel tanks, and damaged areas.
determine the vehicle parts and material as hazardous waste, reusable, recyclable and disposable

modules.module_title: Perform depollution and dismantling of End-of-Life vehicle

pcs.pc_description: report the malfunctions/repairs in the vehicle beyond own scope to the concerned person
take precautions to avoid damage to the vehicle and its components while working on the various mechanical, electrical or High voltage electrical systems of the vehicle
use workshop hand tools/power tools/equipment required for the job as per OEM Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

follow SOP to perform depollution operations and drain vehicle fluids (oil, brake fluid, steering fluid, antifreeze, fuel, refrigerant, etc.), remove the battery, filters, catalyst, wheel balancing weight, parts identified as containing mercury, etc.
store or dispose various liquid/fluids recovered from the vehicle according to the environmental and organisational storage and disposal guidelines
assess vehicle’s pyrotechnic devices and deploy using a suitable procedure or remove them for subsequent neutralisation
disassemble the vehicle by removing engines, transmission systems, batteries, electrical components, wheels, brakes, and body parts such as doors hood bumpers, windows, seats, etc.
carry out the inspection to segregate the components and material further with respect to hazardous waste, reuse, recycle, and dispose
check the condition of removed spare parts/aggregate post disassembly and report to the supervisor if further inspection/cleaning is required, so that parts are ready for resale
Fix tag/label on the spare parts for inventory or shipment and record the vehicle and components detail such as make, model, type, etc.
ensure clean up the spill if any and restore the workstation
use pallet truck or crane to move mechanical or body parts to the desired storage/scrap location
place the components at pre-defined location safely as per storage guideline
maintain the documentation related to depollution, dismantling work performed on the End of Life vehicle
perform scheduled checks, calibration, timely repairs for workshop tools, equipment and workstations
